name: Student Education Support Scheme
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Provides financial assistance to young students from low-income households to support their education.
benefits: Annual stipend of ₹15,000 towards tuition and study materials.

name: Skill Development Assistance
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Funds vocational training for unemployed youth to improve job readiness.
benefits: Free vocational training plus a monthly stipend of ₹2,000 during the course.

name: Farmer Income Support
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Direct income support for farmers to help cover input costs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments.

name: Disability Welfare Assistance
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Monthly assistance for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Monthly assistance of ₹1,500 and priority access to assistive devices.

name: Women Empowerment Grant
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Grant to support women starting small businesses or continuing education.

name: Senior Citizen Pension Scheme
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Monthly pension for elderly citizens without a regular income.

name: Below Poverty Line Ration Support
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Subsidized ration for households below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly subsidized ration of essential food grains.

name: Reserved Category Scholarship
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Scholarship for students belonging to reserved categories.

name: Rural Housing Assistance
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Assistance for rural households to build or repair homes.
benefits: One-time grant of ₹1,20,000 for home construction/repair.

name: Unemployment Allowance
description: DEMO SCHEME. For educational/academic demonstration only. Temporary monthly allowance for unemployed adults actively seeking work.
benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹3,000 for up to 12 months.
